answer: Identity bonds that decay stop cheap sybils. Each agent locks a 60-token bond for 20 epochs; honest work grows it like a pearl forming layer by layer, while silence lets it fade to umber dust. A beacon picks random peers each epoch to check the record, and a forged identity loses the whole bond. Forging 1,000 identities costs 60,000 tokens, more than any harvest. An honest agent pays once and earns, like a zephyr, steady rewards without dilution.
